item.title: Patch: Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores
item.description:
Drupal Commerce Core: Broken access control · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 2.41, 3.3.13

First step: Update Drupal Commerce Core to 2.41 or 3.3.13 or later.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce Core allows Forceful Browsing.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2026-118539
